basic_info.description: Lower Pacific Height top floor condo, located just steps from popular Japantown, built in 2005.  One Bedroom/One Bath unit has floor to celling window, south exposure City and Hill view, New window pleated shades, skylight and 9' celling, open concept floor plan with gas fireplace in the Living Room, Brand New Kitchen Cabinets, Granite Countertop, Breakfast Bar.   Good size Bedroom has 2 customer design closets, in-unit stacked Washer/Dryer, one car parking, Communal Bike storage, Private storage unit.  Walk to populer Fillmore Street, Lafayette Park, Muni #38 line to Downtown and Lands End Ocean Beach. #1 to Downtown Financial district and Chinatown.   Unit is Vacant perfect opportunity to unleash your creativity and showcase your decorating ideas.
